items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: What about people like Bob Cranshaw, Victor Gaskin?

ctx.x: Well, I just enjoy straight-ahead music. What I mean by "straight-ahead" is pick a tune with some changes and within those changes, do whatever we wanted to. I like form. That's my personal thing. I loved listening to Ray Brown do it and, oh, so many people -- Sam Jones -- talking about bass players -- Cecil McBee (PHONETIC) goes out a little bit.
